text: Cody Beaulieu lives in Kissimmee, FL 34741, drives for Spark (Walmart delivery), has two kids with a third on the way.
Cody is building a Lovable-style AI website builder to publish and monetize. Wants everything simple and easy; zero budget — free tiers only, always state prices before anything paid.

Product pricing: 25 free credits to start; 100 credits $12.99 one-time (no subscription); every 3rd 100-pack earns a 150-credit bonus. Costs: 1 credit per build, 0.5 per correction, 40 to publish, 40 upkeep per 30 days.
Cody granted full control of the project: build, fix, and ship without asking, except when money is involved. He hates repeating himself — finish earlier commitments before expanding.
Site theme: black-and-red builder UI, teal chat composer, Facebook-style light profile pages. Generated sites must use real photos, never placeholder blocks, broken images, or default blue links.
Sabrina is the in-app build coach; Beacon Inside is the hidden 24/7 maintenance worker that sweeps published sites and heals broken images.
Planned next: referral program (friend buys 100 credits, referrer gets 100). Facebook auto-posting (30 credits, 6 posts/day) comes LAST.
